thread:
sasha: Hi team — Ive got an H-1B transfer in progress and my EAD expires July 10. Offer start is July 1. If the H-1 approval comes after July 1, can I still enroll in benefits retroactively?

maria (People Ops): Short answer: we can only enroll employees who are on payroll and have a completed I-9. Enrollment retroactive to the original start date is sometimes possible if immigration docs are provided before payroll cutoff and legal signs off.

sasha: Whats the payroll cutoff?

payroll-bot: Payroll cutoff is the 25th of the month for the next-month payroll. Provide authorization docs before cutoff for retroactive processing.

diane (Immigration): If you have a pending change-of-status H-1 petition that triggers cap-gap or auto-extension, provide the I-797C receipt showing the extension language. That can usually be accepted for payroll temporarily.

sasha: If cap-gap doesn't apply, can I do unpaid onboarding so I don't miss training and Slack?

maria (People Ops): Yes — we commonly do "onboarding-only" access: Slack, email, training, and offer paperwork — but no payroll, benefits, or PTO until authorization.

sasha: Will equity vesting be affected?

maria (People Ops): Equity grant paperwork can be completed now; vesting uses your official hire date (we can align it with payroll start or preserve original offer date subject to legal approval).

sasha: Any templates for consulate/travel letter?
diane (Immigration): We have a template. Send me your consulate location and I'll draft a signed letter. Also note that traveling while petition pending may complicate a COS; check first.

sasha: Uploaded receipt and passport scan to candidate portal. Thanks.
maria (People Ops): Received. Well tentatively give "onboarding-only" access on July 1 and hold payroll until I-9 originals are inspected or cap-gap docs are confirmed. Will update thread if anything changes.
